Apprehending the Arcane Form.effect: See active magic, curses, and enchanted items as auras (1-sentence read); also see in total darkness.

Cognitive Supersession of the Inferior O.effect: Telepathically bond with and command one visible normal animal, sharing its senses. It obeys non-suicidal orders but won't fight.

The Coruscating Coffin.effect: One visible creature within 100'/level takes 1d8/level, Physical save for half. 1-HD NPC foes die outright. Ignores non-magical cover.

Damnation of the Sense.effect: Seize control of one sense of a visible creature (blind, deafen, feed false impressions). Mental save; failure = whole scene, success = 1 round.

Decree of Ligneous Dissolution.effect: Annihilate all non-magical plant/fungus matter (wood, rope, cloth) in up to 1 cube/level. Plant-monsters take 1d10/level, Physical save for half.

The Excellent Transpicuous Transformatio.effect: Turn up to one willing target/level invisible. Breaks for all if any subject runs, attacks, or casts.

Imperceptible Cerebral Divulgence.effect: Read a visible creature's surface thoughts and query its memories (1 question/level; each risks ending it on a Mental save). Cast subtly, no gestures.

Ineluctable Shackles of Volition.effect: Enthrall a visible creature's will (Mental save at -Magic). It obeys non-suicidal physical commands but appears dazed; recasting frees prior thralls.

The Long Amber Moment.effect: On Turn: put a touched willing/helpless creature into invulnerable temporal stasis, immune to non-magical harm.

Phantasmal Mimesis.effect: Create a self-acting multi-sensory illusion in up to 1 cube/level. Illusory attackers hit with caster's bonus for 1d8, vanish if struck; disbelief allows a Mental save.

Velocitous Imbuement.effect: On Turn: up to one willing target/level doubles ground move, can run on walls/ceilings and leave melee freely. +1 System Strain to users.

Wardpact Invocation.effect: Either make a creature partly weapon-immune (hits need a Physical save to land, 1 round/2 levels) OR render one visible weapon harmless for the scene.

The Wind of the Final Repose.effect: Living creatures of 4 HD or fewer in a 20' radius fall asleep; roused by damage or a Main Action, else wake at scene's end.

Calculation of the Evoked Servitor.effect: Summon an intelligent familiar (1 HP/level, AC 14, no attack) that obeys any order, even suicidal, and shares a telepathic bond. Can be re-summoned if slain.

Casting Forth the Inner Eye.effect: Scry a distant location through a reflective/luminous surface (within 100'/level or a place you've been). Warded sites are immune; can't repeat a site within a week.

Conjunction of the Inexorable Step.effect: Teleport a visible creature or loose object (<= horse) within 100' to a visible safe spot within a half-mile. Unwilling targets get a Mental save (success swaps the caster instead).

Decree of Lithic Dissolution.effect: Reduce all non-magical stone/earth/mineral in up to 1 cube/level to dust (metal unaffected); may collapse structures. Rock-monsters take 1d10/level, save for half.

Extirpate Arcana.effect: Dispel unwanted magic in a 20' radius. Auto-negates effects from equal/lower-HD casters; else a contested Magic check (higher level +2). Standing magics only suppressed 1d6 rounds.

The Inexorable Imputation.effect: Make a one-sentence statement; all who hear within 40' must Mental save or believe it (unless impossible or abhorrent). Exempt 2 allies/level.

Jade Palanquin of the Faceless God.effect: Conjure a floating 12'x8' stone palanquin that bears up to 2,000 lb at shoulder height; pulled by one bearer.

Mantle of Disjecting Dissection.effect: A willing creature is wreathed in blade-shards; anyone touching/meleeing them makes an Evasion save or takes 1d6+level first. Indiscriminate (hits allies too).

Prudentially Transient Abnegation of Lif.effect: Instant: a target dropped to 0 HP appears gorily dead to all examination, then revives within 2 hours at 2 HP/level (+2 Strain). Destroyed remains can't revive.

Resounding Temporal Echo.effect: Up to one ally/level gains an extra Main Action (not for casting) for 1d4+1 rounds; +1 System Strain per round the bonus is used.

The Verdant Vallation.effect: Grow a 20'-high, 3'-thick wall of vines up to 20'/level wide; 5 HP/level to cut through, optional thorns deal 2d6 to climbers. Persists if rooted in good earth.

Visitation of the Clement Clime.effect: Caster and up to 3 allies/level become immune to mundane heat/cold/acid/electricity; half (or no) damage from magical versions.

Adopt the Simulacular Visage.effect: Transform up to one willing target/level into a perfect simulacrum of any humanoid seen (voice, scent, clothing, language). No special abilities granted.

Conjunct the Vital Viscera.effect: Render up to one subject/level plastic: transfer HP, poisons, diseases, or body parts between willing/bound creatures; a willing target can be absorbed into another.

Exhalation of Congelating Cold.effect: Freeze a radius of 10'/level; living creatures take 1d6/2 levels (Physical save half), liquids freeze 2' deep. Failed save = lose Move action 1d4 rounds.

Foresightful Apprehension.effect: Describe an intended action; the GM tells you the most likely outcome within the next 5 minutes. Once/week per general topic.

The Glass Chimes of the Bamboo Terrace.effect: Summon floating chimes for subtle long-distance messaging (10 miles/level), audible only to chosen targets; shatter them as a Main Action to deal 3d6 in 40'.

The Howl of Light.effect: Detonate a 20' radius blast at a point within 50'/level for 1d8/level (Evasion save half); channels down narrow passages for extra 1d6x10'.

Phobic Storm.effect: Enemies within 40' make a Morale check at -1 or flee; those who hold take 1 damage/level. No effect on the fearless or Morale-12 foes.

Scorn the Fetters of Earth.effect: Caster and up to one ally/level can walk/run through the air in three dimensions; or force one flyer/level to land (Physical save at -Magic).

The Torment of Tumefaction.effect: Curse a visible creature with boils and tumors; vigorous action (not moving) costs 2 dmg/level/round. Main-action Physical save to end; weaker foes are cursed indefinitely.

Touch of Elucidating Intangibility.effect: Touch a non-magical barrier: see/hear through a 10' cube of it, or make it intangible 1 round/level. Anyone caught when it re-solidifies takes 2d10 and is ejected.

Vallation of Specified Exclusion.effect: Draw a line (<=20'/level) that bars a describable kind of target (e.g. 'humans') and their powers, as a wall 100' up. Shatters if the warded are attacked across it.

Calculation of the Phantasmal Eidolon.effect: Summon an ox-sized obedient combatant (4 HD, 20 HP, AC 15, +6/1d8 Shock 2/AC15) that fights to the death. Its damage only knocks out (1 HP after an hour). Pick one quality (fly/mimic/telepathy/use gear).

Contingent Excision of Arcana.effect: Set a trigger to later dispel magic (as Extirpate Arcana) as an Instant action once. Ends when used.

Disjunctive Temporal Reversion.effect: Instant: one creature within 100' replays its current round's actions as if they never happened. Unwilling targets get a Mental save.

Evert the Inwardness.effect: Extract a container's contents into your hands; OR tear out a creature's innards — equal/lower-HD targets save or die, all take 1d10/level (Physical save half).

The Grinding Geas.effect: Bind a visible creature to a one-sentence command (not suicidal/impossible). Defiance brings a wasting disease that kills in 1d6 weeks; complying reverses it. Mental save if able to resist.

Obnubilation of the Will.effect: A helpless/restrained creature makes a Mental save or becomes an intelligent, initiative-using slave (suicidal acts need another save). Cap = 2x level thralls; obvious tics give it away.

Ochre Sigil of Juxtaposition.effect: Cast in two parts within a mile (one slot): inscribe a sigil, then swap everything within 10' of you with everything within 10' of the sigil. Weak unwilling targets get no save.

Pierce the Pallid Gate.effect: Open a cart-sized rift between two known points within 100'/level (>=20' apart) to see and pass through. Closable as an Instant action.

Sigil of Aeolian Auctoritas.effect: Conjure a 100'x30' gust (Physical save or bowled back 30' for 1d6 and lose next Main); or outdoors, control local weather for 1 hour/level.

Abdication of Temporal Presence.effect: Caster and up to one ally/level step outside time for 1d4+1 free rounds while the world freezes; they can't affect outside objects or those still in time.

Banishment to the Black Glass Labyrinth.effect: Exile all but the caster in a 10' radius (within 300') into an infinite obsidian maze. Mental save to return next round; <=5-HD victims get no save and are trapped until the caster dies.

The Dazzling Prismatic Hemicycle.effect: A 100' cone forces a Physical save; failures roll 1d6 for a random gruesome fate (dust, sleep, insanity, petrification, or enthrallment).

Deluge of Hell.effect: Rain ruin on a 200'/level radius (within 3,000') for 1d8/level (Physical save half); 4-HD-or-less targets die. Outdoors only; caster saves or takes a quarter of the damage.

The Earth as Clay.effect: Over an hour, mold natural stone/earth within 300'/level — raise hills, dig tunnels, form simple buildings. Can't work earth shaped by intelligent hands within 1,000'.

Invocation of the Invincible Citadel.effect: Instant: raise a 20'-radius force bubble around the caster, impervious to attacks, magic, and matter from either side. Those inside may leave but not return.

Open the High Road.effect: Open a one-way gate from the caster to a prepared point within 100 miles/level (1-hour attunement). Cart-sized, 1 minute/level. 1-in-10 chance to misfire 1d100 miles off.

Elemental Resilience.effect: Unharmed by mundane cold or sub-furnace heat; half damage from magical/intense flame or frost. (Granted at 1st level.)

Elemental Sparks.effect: Conjure petty flame, water, ice, stone, or wind for minor tricks. Can't meaningfully solve a problem more than once/session. (Granted at 1st level.)

Beckoned Deluge.effect: Conjure water drenching 1 cube/level within 50'/level — ruins bowstrings, douses fire, deals 1d6/level to fiery supernatural creatures. Persists; hydrates ten/level.

Earthsight.effect: See solid object outlines in total darkness and peer through earth/stone up to your level in feet.

Elemental Blast.effect: Hurl an elemental bolt at a target within 50'/level (Magic + Int/Cha/Dex + level to hit, no melee penalty) for 1d6 + level + attribute.

Flamesight.effect: See thermal gradients (and living creatures) in total darkness; optionally make your eyes shed 30' of light.

Pavis of Elements.effect: Conjure an elemental barrier granting +4 AC (stacking, but never above AC 18) while Committed.

Petrifying Stare.effect: A visible creature makes a Physical save or is partly petrified, losing its Move action for half your level (round up). Flyers land, swimmers sink.

Rune of Destruction.effect: Lay a trap-rune on an adjacent surface (1 hour/level); anyone coming within 2' triggers a 5' elemental blast for 2d6 + level.

Steps of Air.effect: A visible ally flies at normal Move for 1 round/level; or use Instantly to negate one target's falling damage.

Stunning Shock.effect: A metal-wearing or wet creature within 50'/level loses its next Main action (Physical save downgrades to losing its Move). Once/scene per target.

Thermal Shield.effect: Negate one instance of fire or frost damage to a visible ally or object.

Aqueous Harmony.effect: Caster and up to a dozen allies gain water-breathing, pressure/cold tolerance, clear underwater sight, and unhindered movement and attacks underwater.

Flame Scrying.effect: Sense all open flames within 30'/level and scry through one chosen flame, seeing and hearing around it while you stay focused.

Elemental Favor.effect: Appeal to a <=10' cube of earth, stone, water, flame, or air; it reshapes/moves as asked, holding the new form until scene's end (or permanently if stable).

Elemental Spy.effect: Enchant a stone, bit of liquid, flame, or smoke; for 1 day/level, see and hear around the object as a Main action while it survives.

Boreal Wings.effect: A visible ally within 100' flies at twice their Move; descends gently if it ends aloft. Lasts a scene (longer at higher levels).

The Burrower Below.effect: Carve a stabilizable tunnel through natural stone/earth up to 20'/level long, 10' across (only 2'/level through worked stone).

Flame Without End.effect: Make a flame (<= caster's size) eternal and non-consuming; resists all but burial/immersion. As a weapon it adds +2 damage. One free per level.

Pact of Stone and Sea.effect: Pick earth/water/fire/wind; a visible target is immune to that element's mundane harm and secondary effects (e.g. fire-pacted can't be boiled) for the scene.

Elemental Vallation.effect: Raise a 10'/level wall of earth (20 HP), fire (3d6+level passing through), water (2d6 + ejection), or air (1d6+level electric, invisible).

Like the Stones.effect: Take on an element's qualities for the scene: stone (stabilize, ignore 3 dmg), water (squeeze through gaps), air (fly, +4 AC vs ranged), or fire (1d6 to melee foes, heat-immune).

Wind Walking.effect: A target and their gear become an insubstantial mist, harmable only by cloud-disrupting forces; they move freely in 3D but can't manipulate objects.

Calcifying Scourge.effect: A visible target within 100' makes a Physical save or is turned to stone until the caster undoes it (success = lose Move action 1d6 rounds). Damage while petrified carries over.

Elemental Guardian.effect: Animate a human-sized mass of an element as a loyal 4-HD guardian (AC 15, +6/1d10) with element-based perks (earth = 6 HD, fire = Shock, water = AC 18, air = flight). One at a time.

Fury of the Elements.effect: Erupt molten rock and steam on a point within 200'/level for 10d6 in 30', then the zone wanders 1d6x10' randomly each round for 1d6 rounds. Molten remnants linger all day.

Tremors of the Depths.effect: Call up an earthquake over a 500' radius that topples unreinforced structures, tunnels, and caves. Builds over 5 minutes; negated only if dispelled within a minute.

Healing Touch.effect: For the scene, heal a touched ally 2d6 + Heal skill as a Main action (+1 System Strain to the target each time). (Granted at 1st level.)

Empowered Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch also adds your level to the healing done.

Facile Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch no longer requires you to Commit Effort to activate it.

Far Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch can reach a visible target within 10'/level.

Final Repose.effect: A visible creature takes a Physical-save penalty equal to your Heal skill for the scene; if dropped to 0 HP they die outright with no stabilization or revival.

Healer's Eye.effect: While Committed, use a Main action to diagnose diseases/poisons, read physiology and current HP; also see living creatures regardless of light.

Limb Restoration.effect: (8th level+) Commit all remaining Effort to regrow a touched target's missing limb/organ or efface a debility; their System Strain is maxed.

Purge Ailment.effect: Cure one poison or disease in a touched ally (revives poison-deaths within 6 minutes). Magical ailments may need a Heal check vs 8+. 7th level: only Scene effort.

Refined Restoration.effect: You and up to a dozen allies you tend before sleep lose 2 System Strain from a night's rest instead of 1.

Revive the Fallen.effect: (8th level+) Revive a touched creature dead within 1 minute/level (not dismembered/incinerated). Strain is maxed; they wake after 24 hours at 1 HP.

Swift Healer.effect: Your Healing Touch can be used as an On Turn action once/day per level (not twice/round on one target).

The Healer's Knife.effect: Your Healing Touch can instead deal its healing amount as damage to a living target (you take 1 System Strain). Melee use needs a Punch attack (hit bonus = Heal).

Tireless Vigor.effect: While Committed, your need to eat/drink/breathe/sleep does not worsen and you regenerate 1 lost HP per hour.

Vital Furnace.effect: Negate the damage from a non-mortal injury you just took. Also: you auto-stabilize at 0 HP and wake in 10 minutes at 1 HP.

Bonetalker.effect: See and speak with any undead; Commit Effort to read a visible undead's surface thoughts and orders. Mindless undead won't attack you unless commanded.

Cold Flesh.effect: No sleep needed, abstract pain only, take at most 2 damage from any Shock, and gain natural AC 12 + half level (round down).

Consume Life Energy.effect: With a Punch or a consecrated melee weapon, heal 1d6 per hit (up to the damage dealt, never above the target's remaining HP).

False Death.effect: While Committed you appear dead to mundane examination (lose Main actions but move and perceive; no bodily needs; poisons/diseases pause). Up to 1 day/level.

Gravesight.effect: While Committed, see living creatures' life energies (and their sicknesses/poisons) as glowing patterns, and see normally in total darkness.

Keeper of the Gate.effect: At will, Mortally Wounded creatures within 20'/level die unrevivably; or Commit Effort to auto-stabilize any/all within range (+1 Strain each).

Life Bridge.effect: For the scene, shift HP between two willing/helpless creatures (>= dog-sized) you touch — even enough to Mortally Wound the donor, but not past the recipient's max.

Master of Bones.effect: Undead roll saves vs your powers twice, worse result; Commit Effort to negate one attack/power/spell from an undead (unless it has 2x your levels in HD).

Red Harvest.effect: When an intelligent 1+ HD creature dies within 50', heal 1d6 + level OR gain +4 on your next hit roll this scene. Once/round, no stacking.

Unaging.effect: You no longer naturally age (hale to species max +20%/level) and become immune to poisons and diseases.

Uncanny Ichor.effect: Predators won't bite you. Puncture/stab wounds can Mortally Wound but not kill you unless you're utterly pincushioned or catastrophically maimed.

Unliving Persistence.effect: Auto-stabilize when Mortally Wounded; can be used on a touched ally instead. Won't save the dismembered or finally-slain.

Command the Dead.effect: Bind up to 2x level HD of visible undead within 100' (Mental save at -Magic); the fully-bound become suicidally loyal. Cap of 2x level HD held at once.

Query the Skull.effect: A corpse dead no more than 1 day/level answers 1 truthful question/level, tersely and literally. Once per corpse.

Smite the Dead.effect: Blast a 20' radius within 100'/level; hostile undead take 1d10/level and those of <= your level in HD save or are destroyed. May Commit Effort to make it free of a slot.

Terrible Liveliness.effect: Give an undead the tangible semblance of a healthy living being at any age, able to do all activities its cognition allows. One disguise/level; not on unwilling sentients.

Augment Mortal Vitality.effect: A willing target gains a Physical-save bonus equal to your Magic skill and auto-stabilizes when Mortally Wounded; once/scene heal a non-mortal injury. +1 Strain.

Enfeebling Wave.effect: Living creatures in a 20' radius (within 100') save or, for the scene, halve their Move and roll attacks/damage twice taking the worse (success = next turn only).

Final Death.effect: Curse one target/level: for the scene they can't regain HP and die instantly if Mortally Wounded. A Physical save after each failed healing ends it.

Raise Corpse.effect: Animate a skeleton/corpse as a loyal 1-HD servant (AC 13, +1/1d6) with a human degree of intelligence but only vague memories. Active count <= caster level.

Compel Flesh.effect: A living creature or bodied undead within 100' is paralyzed unless you command it each turn (On Turn). Physical save each turn to break free, taking 1 dmg/level per attempt.

Festering Curse.effect: Force a corpse's qualities on a living target: food tastes of ash, no physical pleasure, -2 social checks. No injury, just misery, until lifted. Stronger foes save.

Forgetting the Grave.effect: A willing target cannot die for 1 round/level; at 0 HP they lose their Move but act on (further damage forces Physical saves). At the end, 0-HP targets are Mortally Wounded.

Merge Souls.effect: Bond two touched willing/helpless creatures to pool HP and communicate telepathically; neither dies until the pool hits 0 (then both Mortally Wounded). Ends at daybreak.

Boneshaper.effect: Reshape a willing/helpless living or undead body over an hour — add/remove limbs, recolor, retexture. Can shift a Cha/physical modifier +1/-1 (max +2/-2). Imitation: Dex/Magic vs 10.

Raise Grave Knight.effect: Raise a 4+ HD corpse as a strong, fully intelligent, loyal undead knight (4 HD, AC 15, +6/1d10) that recalls its life and regains all HP at dusk. One at a time.

Call of the Tomb.effect: Enemies within 40' save or, for 1 round/level (success = 1 round), are auto-hit by all attacks with maximized damage dice and lose all special damage defenses.

Everlasting.effect: Instant: for 5 rounds no allied creature within 50' can drop below 1 HP. At the end, the caster is left at 1 HP. Once/day per creature.

Martial Style.effect: Your hit die is at least 1d6/level and your Punch hit bonus is at least an Expert's. At 3rd level, Punch attacks count as magic weapons. (Granted at 1st level.)

Unarmed Might.effect: Your unarmed damage rises by level (per the Vowed table), and you add Punch skill to it. (Granted at 1st level.)

Unarmored Defense.effect: Unarmored and shieldless, your base Armor Class is 13 + half your level (round down). (Granted at 1st level.)

Brutal Counter.effect: After an enemy's melee attack on you (hit or miss), make a free physical attack or one-Main-action offensive ability against them. Usable during Total Defense.

Faultless Awareness.effect: You cannot be surprised and wake from deep sleep in time to respond to imminent peril.

Hurling Throw.effect: After a successful attack, the target (<= ox-sized) saves or is thrown up to 10', falls prone, and takes your attack's damage. Once/round per target.

The Inward Eye.effect: While Committed, you sense your surroundings like normal sight regardless of darkness, mist, or blindness.

Leap of the Heavens.effect: Leap up to your full Move horizontally (half vertically); or use Instantly to negate falling damage from any height.

Master's Vigor.effect: You keep youthful vigor for your full lifespan and regain 2 lost HP per hour naturally.

Mob Justice.effect: For the scene, foes can't Swarm-attack you, and you're immune to Shock while meleeing 2+ foes. Using it disrupts your spellcasting that round.

Nimble Ascent.effect: For the scene, move up vertical/overhanging surfaces and difficult terrain at full Move with no slipping (needs one free hand, not on glass/enchanted surfaces).

Purified Body.effect: Cure any disease or poison on you, or negate your need for sleep/food/water/air for 24 hours.

Revivifying Breath.effect: Heal yourself 1d6 + level with no Strain (usable even at 0 HP, but then Commits all remaining Effort). Once/scene.

Shattering Strike.effect: After a round of stillness, shatter a wooden barrier (1'/level deep; stone at 4th, metal at 7th). Against an immobilized creature, the blow does 1d12/level.

Style Weaponry.effect: Pick three weapon classes; use Punch for their hit rolls (no Punch damage bonus, but Martial Style applies).

Unobtrusive Step.effect: Once/scene, reroll a failed Sneak check or an impersonation check.
